answer: One enforceable rule: sample three unrelated data feeds and require independent corroboration. Clustering on shared timing signatures exposes the operator. Because it works by making the twenty-first clone cost more than the first twenty combined, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The forge of work and the saffron of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a nebula to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
